# What the controller would do: persistence-rule replay (generated by topo/persistence.py)

Real snapshot streams replayed in time order through the controller's own `_persistent_top` (risk > 0.85 in 3 of the last 4 checks, current check included). Normal traffic = Boutique's held-out fault-free half plus the normals of the fault run; Bookinfo's holdout (never used to learn a baseline). A false alarm is an alarm ONSET on normal traffic: each one would be a reroute (or ACTION_BLOCKED where no playbook exists). The MLP is trained on simulated data only.
